supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: distinct extension beyond the outer corners of the orbital frame

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked intensity difference between the light grey muzzle and the dark periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: medium 2D vertical thickness with a neutral resting pose

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: visible structural notch or fold in the upper helix of the left ear

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: light-colored depigmented spots or speckles on the muzzle skin
